en: Colored view of a broad, tree‑lined boulevard with ornate late‑19th‑century buildings and café awnings on the right and several pedestrians in the street. A church spire rises in the distance. The caption at top reads the city's names in Hungarian, German and Romanian and identifies the boulevard. The reverse is a divided back headed LEVELEZŐ-LAP with a green 5 Filler Magyar Kir. Posta stamp and German cursive message addressed to Herr Gustav Grüber in Hermannstadt.
